_note: Admin > API & webhooks. Edit the wording here.
title: API & webhooks
intro: Integrate third-party applications to dispatch and inspect messages via Mail App, or stream real-time event notifications whenever email activity occurs.
off: The API isn't switched on for this install yet. The README shows how to switch it on. Webhooks already work.
addressHelp: Authorise external requests using an API secret key passed via standard bearer authentication.

keys.title: API keys
keys.intro: Restrict key permissions to designated mailboxes and specific scopes (such as read-only or outbound sending).
keys.empty: Generate an independent key for each connecting service, allowing you to revoke access for single integrations without affecting others.
keys.deleteBody: Apps using this key stop working straight away. This can't be undone.

scopeHelp.read: List, read and search email, and download attachments
scopeHelp.send: Send new emails, replies and forwards
scopeHelp.organise: Mark as read, star, move to a folder and label

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.intro: Deliver immediate HTTP POST notifications to an external endpoint whenever an email is received or sent. Outgoing payloads include a cryptographic signature header, enabling your receiving server to verify payload authenticity.
webhooks.empty: Add an HTTPS endpoint to begin receiving automated, real-time message event notifications.
webhooks.deleteBody: Mail App stops sending to {url}. This can't be undone.

newKey.title: New API key
newKey.name: Name
newKey.namePlaceholder: For example: Zapier, or our website's contact form
newKey.shownBody: Copy it now and keep it somewhere safe, such as a password manager. For your security it won't be shown again. Anyone with this key can use the mailboxes you ticked.

newWebhook.title: New webhook
newWebhook.name: Name (optional)
newWebhook.shownBody: Give this signing secret to the app at the other end, so it can check each message came from Mail App. You can see it again from the webhook's menu.

log.title: Delivery log: {name}
log.intro: The latest tries, newest first. A try that fails is tried again after 1 minute, 10 minutes and 1 hour.
log.empty: Nothing sent yet. Use Send a test to try it.

secret.title: Signing secret: {name}
secret.body: Every message carries a Mail-App-Signature header made with this secret. The developer guide shows how to check it.
